claim.proof: The prefix pencil is Z times a moment matrix because u=0. The moment determinant is Vandermonde(x_0,...,x_j)^2, nonzero because the descriptor-domain prefix elements are distinct.  Therefore Delta_A(Z)=c_A Z^(j+1) with c_A != 0.
claim.summary: For every A in 385..426, the synthetic moment syndrome u=0, v_m=sum_i x_i^m using the first j+1 descriptor-domain elements has a full-rank prefix regular minor, and the closed-form determinant has exact root set {0}.
